Ravi (docs): Heads-up: I'm drafting a migration note for teams moving from the old autoscale schema (v1) to autoscaler v2 in Dedicated docs. Planning to include a small Go SDK snippet and a few real-world gotchas. PTAL?

Sophie (eng): Love that. Could you include an example mapping old keys: `max_nodes` -> `max_instances`, and `scale_window` -> `cooldown_seconds`? We've seen folks copy the old fields and fail silently.

Ravi (docs): Yep. Drafted mapping + CLI examples. Also thinking to call out the API rename: `burst_policy` -> `burst_strategy` (this broke a customer script last month).

Tate (platform): Important: add an example of tenant label enforcement for strict isolation so ops don't accidentally assign regulated tenants to a shared reserved pool. Maybe show the recommended label set.

Ravi (docs): Added label snippet and a short troubleshooting bullet: "If tasks are routed off-pool, check reserved_pool assignment and tenant:regulatory label".

Maya (sre): Can you include an ops play for rollbacks? We had a case where autoscale v2 aggressively spun up GPUs. Suggest a tiny YAML rollback snippet and a one-line command to pin to previous policy.

Ravi (docs): Good call. Included rollback example: `redwoodctl set-autoscale --policy-id old-policy-123 --apply`. Kept it intentionally minimal.

Sophie (eng): About the Go snippet 12; teams using our internal onboarding templates prefer short idiomatic code. Maybe show initializing a Dedicated client and requesting a quantized model variant with pinned version.

Ravi (docs): Drafted this Go example: 
```go
import "github.com/redwood/incidence"
cli := incidence.NewDedicatedClient("pool-xyz")
resp, _ := cli.Generate(context.Background(), incidence.GenerateParams{Model: "llama-q4:2026-01-15", Prompt: "Summarize..."})
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
Is that realistic?

Tate (platform): The package path looks off. Our Go SDK is `github.com/redwood/redwood-go`. Also call out that pinning timestamp-based model versions is recommended for regulated use cases.

Ravi (docs): Fixed package path and added sentence about pinning.

Infra Bot: Link-check queued for PR 5158.

Sophie (eng): One more: include a tiny section on quantization tradeoffs and a pointer to Optimize: "Quantized models reduce GPU memory and cost; may slightly change token probabilities - run your eval set."

Ravi (docs): Added that. Also removed two stale links that pointed to old handbook pages (they 404).

Maya (sre): LGTM from SRE side. Please add a note to the release notes to mention the `burst_strategy` rename so infra-ops can scan for outdated configs.

Ravi (docs): Added to Release Notes draft in the PR description.

Infra Bot: PR 5158 created by @Ravi.

Sophie (eng): Quick nit: in the YAML sample, change `min_nodes` to `min_instances` (we deprecated nodes naming).

Ravi (docs): Updated YAML. Running link-check locally then will push.

Infra Bot: Link-check: 0 broken links. CI: unit docs lint passed.

Ravi (docs): Merged PR and backported to on-prem fork (cherry-pick 2b7a3f).

Tate (platform): Thanks! Can someone open a tiny onboarding repo issue to add the Go snippet to the 'Dedicated quickstart' template?

Sophie (eng): I'll take that.

Ravi (docs): Filed docs-meta #812 to track onboarding update. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
